notes.title: Weapon • Electric Voice •
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41187929/dd519d1b32c004b0ea58a29221135fd744e5b193.gif"][/img]

Electric Voice - A unique and unusual voice-activated device which can inflict electrical damage on opponents with diodes embedded in their skulls. The diodes receive all charges fired from the device. This tool is designed to pacify dangerous psychopaths and cannibals. The device functions like a stun gun, but rather than having to make physical contact with electrified probes, a simple shout from the user generates a current of high voltage which reaches out for and stuns the nearest enemy. The longer you shout, the longer the device produces current. If you yell long enough, the enemy's head may rupture from the onslaught. It all depends on how you utilize the device. You can run a stable current to simply stun enemies and save charge, or you can scream continuously and mercilessly kill your enemies. The device will respond to your voice either way. Other utilities of this device include the control of electric doors, lamps, and objects that need power to function. Remember that this device has limited charge. When necessary it must be recharged from a special electric box.



I will frequently publish secret documents related to the P & H SECRET LABORATORY. Want to know more? Stay tuned! Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Update #1 FIRE AND ASHES
notes.content:
